# messq_doctor

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq doctor

diagnose configuration and operations in prose

### Synopsis

Run opinionated health checks over a running daemon (--addr) or an offline data directory (--data-dir) and print prose findings with exact fix commands.

Checks are pure functions over one collected snapshot; anything they cannot see is reported as [skip] with a reason, never silently omitted. An unreachable daemon is itself a fail finding — doctor is designed to run when things are already broken, so it never exits 6.

```
messq doctor [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq doctor
  messq doctor --data-dir /var/lib/messq --fail-on warn --quiet
  messq doctor --list
  messq doctor --explain storage.wal_size
```

### Options

```
      --backup-dir string       enables the backup.* checks against this directory
      --backup-max-age string   age at which backup.stale fires (default "168h")
      --data-dir string         offline source: diagnose this data directory read-only
      --explain string          print the teaching paragraph for one check id
      --fail-on string          what makes the exit code 1: info|warn|fail|never (default "warn")
  -h, --help                    help for doctor
      --idle-after string       threshold for the consumer.idle* checks (default "24h")
      --list                    print the registered checks and their summaries
      --only strings            comma-separated check ids or family globs to include
      --since string            analysis window for event- and metric-derived checks (default "1h")
      --skip strings            comma-separated check ids or family globs to exclude
```
